title: Relationships and Social Life
focus: 约会, 分手, 和好, 信任, 背叛, 面子, 人情, 应酬, 客套, 相处, 沟通, 尊重, 体谅, 介意, 打扰, 聚会, 拉黑, 暧昧, 误会
body:
Family conversation covers the people at home, not dating, friendships, work dinners or office politics. This set covers romance, conflict and repair, and the social machinery of face and favors that adult life in China runs on.

## Words

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 约会 | yuēhuì | to go on a date / a date |
| 分手 | fēnshǒu | to break up |
| 矛盾 | máodùn | friction / conflict |
| 和好 | héhǎo | to make up |
| 信任 | xìnrèn | to trust |
| 背叛 | bèipàn | to betray |
| 面子 | miànzi | face / dignity |
| 人情 | rénqíng | a favor owed / social obligation |
| 应酬 | yìngchou | to socialize for work |
| 客套 | kètào | empty politeness / standing on ceremony |
| 相处 | xiāngchǔ | to get along with |
| 沟通 | gōutōng | to communicate |
| 尊重 | zūnzhòng | to respect |
| 体谅 | tǐliàng | to be understanding |
| 体贴 | tǐtiē | to be considerate / thoughtful |
| 介意 | jièyì | to mind |
| 打扰 | dǎrǎo | to disturb / bother |
| 聚会 | jùhuì | party / get-together |
| 拉黑 | lāhēi | to block |
| 暧昧 | àimèi | flirty but undefined |
| 谈恋爱 | tán liàn'ài | to be in a romantic relationship |
| 出轨 | chūguǐ | to cheat on |
| 相亲 | xiāngqīn | blind date / to go on an arranged date |
| 保持联系 | bǎochí liánxì | to keep in touch |
| 疏远 | shūyuǎn | to drift apart / grow distant |
| 误会 | wùhuì | misunderstanding / to misunderstand |
| 情商 | qíngshāng | emotional intelligence |

## Which word?

- **相信 vs 信任**: 相信 is believing a claim (我相信你说的). 信任 is trusting a person over time (失去信任).
- **尊重 vs 尊敬**: 尊重 is respecting someone's choices or rights. 尊敬 is looking up to elders, teachers or leaders.
- **体谅 vs 体贴 vs 理解**: 理解 is understanding. 体谅 is making allowances for someone's situation. 体贴 is actively looking after someone's needs.
- **沟通 vs 交流**: 沟通 fixes a gap or problem (缺乏沟通). 交流 is exchanging ideas (文化交流).
- **客气 vs 客套**: 客气 is normal politeness (别客气). 客套 is formulaic politeness that keeps distance.
- **介意 vs 在意**: 介意 is minding or objecting (你介意吗？). 在意 is caring about something (他很在意别人的看法).
- **约会 vs 谈恋爱 vs 相亲**: 约会 is going out on dates. 谈恋爱 is being a couple. 相亲 is an arranged meeting set up by family or friends.

## Examples

- 他们上个月分手了。 tāmen shàng ge yuè fēnshǒu le: They broke up last month
- 他们吵完架第二天就和好了。 tāmen chǎo wán jià dì-èr tiān jiù héhǎo le: They made up the day after their fight
- 当着大家的面批评他，太不给他面子了。 dāngzhe dàjiā de miàn pīpíng tā, tài bù gěi tā miànzi le: Criticizing him in front of everyone made him lose face
- 他帮过我，我欠他一个人情。 tā bāngguo wǒ, wǒ qiàn tā yí gè rénqíng: He helped me before, so I owe him a favor
- 他今晚有个应酬，不回家吃饭。 tā jīnwǎn yǒu ge yìngchou, bù huí jiā chīfàn: He has a work dinner tonight, so he won't eat at home
- 他这个人很好相处。 tā zhège rén hěn hǎo xiāngchǔ: He's very easy to get along with
- 你们俩得好好沟通一下。 nǐmen liǎ děi hǎohǎo gōutōng yíxià: You two need to really talk things through
- 他最近压力很大，你多体谅一下。 tā zuìjìn yālì hěn dà, nǐ duō tǐliàng yíxià: He's been under a lot of stress, try to cut him some slack
- 她把前男友拉黑了。 tā bǎ qián nányǒu lāhēi le: She blocked her ex-boyfriend
- 你误会了，我不是那个意思。 nǐ wùhuì le, wǒ bú shì nàge yìsi: You've misunderstood, that's not what I meant

cards.English: to go on a date / a date (romantic)
cards.Example: 他们俩最近在约会。 tāmen liǎ zuìjìn zài yuēhuì: Those two have been dating lately
cards.Notes: 谈恋爱 = to be in a committed relationship; 约会 can be just going out.

cards.Example: 他们上个月分手了。 tāmen shàng ge yuè fēnshǒu le: They broke up last month
cards.Notes: Separable: 分了手. 离婚 = divorce.

cards.Example: 婆媳之间有点矛盾。 póxí zhījiān yǒu diǎn máodùn: There's some friction between the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law
cards.Notes: 闹矛盾 = to fall out. Also means 'contradictory' or 'conflicted': 我心里很矛盾.

cards.Example: 他们吵完架第二天就和好了。 tāmen chǎo wán jià dì-èr tiān jiù héhǎo le: They made up the day after their fight
cards.Notes: 和好如初 = back to how things were.

cards.Example: 我很信任他，什么都跟他说。 wǒ hěn xìnrèn tā, shénme dōu gēn tā shuō: I trust him completely, I tell him everything
cards.Notes: 相信 = believe what someone says; 信任 = trust the person.

cards.Example: 被最好的朋友背叛，真的很难受。 bèi zuì hǎo de péngyou bèipàn, zhēn de hěn nánshòu: Being betrayed by your best friend really hurts
当着大家的面批评他，太不给他面子了。 dāngzhe dàjiā de miàn pīpíng tā, tài bù gěi tā miànzi le: Criticizing him in front of everyone made him lose face
cards.Notes: 给面子 give face, 丢面子 lose face, 爱面子 be image-conscious.

cards.Example: 他帮过我，我欠他一个人情。 tā bāngguo wǒ, wǒ qiàn tā yí gè rénqíng: He helped me before, so I owe him a favor
cards.Notes: 欠人情 = owe a favor; 还人情 = repay one.

cards.English: to socialize for work (business dinners, drinking)
cards.Example: 他今晚有个应酬，不回家吃饭。 tā jīnwǎn yǒu ge yìngchou, bù huí jiā chīfàn: He has a work dinner tonight, so he won't eat at home
cards.Notes: Implies obligation, not fun. Noun or verb.

cards.Example: 都是自己人，别客套了。 dōu shì zìjǐrén, bié kètào le: We're all family here, no need for formalities
cards.Notes: 客气 = polite (everyday); 客套 = formulaic, hollow politeness. 客套话 = polite phrases.

cards.Example: 他这个人很好相处。 tā zhège rén hěn hǎo xiāngchǔ: He's very easy to get along with
cards.Notes: 合得来 / 处得来 = get on well.

cards.Example: 你们俩得好好沟通一下。 nǐmen liǎ děi hǎohǎo gōutōng yíxià: You two need to really talk things through
cards.Notes: 交流 = exchange ideas or culture; 沟通 = bridge a gap to resolve something.

cards.English: to respect (a choice, a person's rights)
cards.Example: 我尊重你的决定。 wǒ zūnzhòng nǐ de juédìng: I respect your decision
cards.Notes: 尊敬 = revere elders or superiors; 尊重 = respect choices, privacy, people as equals.

cards.Example: 他最近压力很大，你多体谅一下。 tā zuìjìn yālì hěn dà, nǐ duō tǐliàng yíxià: He's been under a lot of stress, try to cut him some slack
cards.Notes: Stronger and warmer than 理解; it means making allowances.

cards.English: to be considerate / thoughtful (in caring for someone)
cards.Example: 她老公很体贴。 tā lǎogōng hěn tǐtiē: Her husband is very thoughtful
cards.Notes: 体贴 = actively caring; 体谅 = forgiving someone's situation.

cards.Example: 你介意我坐这儿吗？ nǐ jièyì wǒ zuò zhèr ma: Do you mind if I sit here?
cards.Notes: 在意 = care about; 介意 = object to.

cards.Example: 不好意思，打扰一下。 bù hǎoyìsi, dǎrǎo yíxià: Sorry to bother you
cards.Notes: 打扰了 is a polite opener or sign-off when visiting or interrupting.

cards.Example: 周末有个同学聚会。 zhōumò yǒu ge tóngxué jùhuì: There's a class reunion this weekend
cards.Notes: 派对 is a Western-style party; 聚会 covers any gathering.

cards.Example: 她把前男友拉黑了。 tā bǎ qián nányǒu lāhēi le: She blocked her ex-boyfriend
cards.Notes: 删好友 = unfriend.

cards.Example: 他们俩关系有点暧昧。 tāmen liǎ guānxi yǒu diǎn àimèi: There's something going on between those two
cards.Notes: Also means 'ambiguous' about statements: 态度暧昧.

cards.English: to be in a romantic relationship
cards.Example: 他们谈恋爱谈了三年才结婚。 tāmen tán liàn'ài tán le sān nián cái jiéhūn: They dated for three years before getting married
他出轨被老婆发现了。 tā chūguǐ bèi lǎopo fāxiàn le: His wife found out he was cheating
cards.Notes: Literally 'go off the rails'.

cards.English: blind date / to go on an arranged date
cards.Example: 我妈又让我去相亲。 wǒ mā yòu ràng wǒ qù xiāngqīn: My mom is making me go on another blind date
毕业以后我们一直保持联系。 bìyè yǐhòu wǒmen yìzhí bǎochí liánxì: We've kept in touch since graduation
cards.Notes: Common sign-off: 以后保持联系！

cards.Example: 他结婚以后跟我们疏远了。 tā jiéhūn yǐhòu gēn wǒmen shūyuǎn le: He drifted away from us after he got married
他情商很高，跟谁都处得来。 tā qíngshāng hěn gāo, gēn shéi dōu chǔ de lái: He has high EQ, he gets along with everyone
cards.Notes: 智商 = IQ.

cards.English: Thanks for going to the trouble. (after someone does you a favor)
cards.Notes: Before the favor, 麻烦你…… means 'could you please...'.

cards.English: Let's not fall out over this.
cards.Hanzi: 别因为这件事伤了和气。
cards.Pinyin: bié yīnwèi zhè jiàn shì shāng le héqi
cards.Notes: 伤和气 = damage good relations.

cards.English: I didn't mean anything by it, don't take it to heart.
cards.Hanzi: 我没别的意思，你别往心里去。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ méi bié de yìsi, nǐ bié wǎng xīn lǐ qù
cards.Notes: 别往心里去 = don't take it personally.
